simple.summary: עוּץ (ʻûwts) means to consult First listed occurrence: Isa 8 10.

definitions.full: H5779. uts [ עוּץ ] verb counsel, plan (Aramaic id. ; || form of יעץ ); — only Qal Imperative masculine plural עֻ֫צוּ Judg 19:30 (GFM reads עֵצָה , but see Bu), Isa 8:10 with accusative of congnate meaning with verb עֵצָה . (Sta ThLz 1894, Apr. 28, 235 derives עֻצוּ from יעץ ).
